units.source_text: 藤壶皇后闻到源氏身上特有的衣香，觉得突如其来，吓了一跳，身子俯伏在席地上了。

en.t: When Empress Fujitsubo caught the distinctive fragrance of Genji's robes, it came so suddenly that she was startled and fell face down upon the mat.

units.source_text: 源氏大将怨她不转过脸来向着他，心中懊恨，只管拉她的衣服。

en.t: General Genji, hurt that she would not turn her face toward him, was bitterly distressed and kept pulling at her clothing.

units.source_text: 藤壶皇后连忙将外衣卸去，想就此脱身。

en.t: Empress Fujitsubo hurriedly slipped off her outer robe, hoping to free herself that way.

units.source_text: 但源氏大将无意中已把她的头发连衣服一起握住，因此皇后无法逃走。

en.t: But without realizing it, General Genji had grasped her hair along with the robe, so the Empress could not escape.

units.source_text: 她懊恼之极，但叹此乃前世冤孽，异常悲伤。

en.t: She was overcome with anguish, lamenting that this must be an ill-fated bond from a former life, and she was deeply sorrowful.

units.source_text: 男方近来也曾努力抑制，可是现在已难隐忍，心绪混乱，如醉如痴，只管啼啼哭哭地诉说千愁万恨。

en.t: The man too had lately tried hard to restrain himself, but now he could endure no longer; his heart was in turmoil, and as if drunk or possessed, he wept and poured out all his grief and resentment.

units.source_text: 藤壶皇后心中很不愉快，不能作答，只是勉强言道：

en.t: Empress Fujitsubo was deeply troubled and could not answer, but at last forced herself to say:

units.source_text: “我今天心情异常恶劣，且待将来好些，再与你会晤吧。”

en.t: "I am feeling terribly unwell today. Please wait until I am somewhat better, and then I will meet with you again."

units.source_text: 但源氏大将还是滔滔不绝地诉说衷情。

en.t: But General Genji still went on endlessly pouring out his true feelings.

units.source_text: 其中也有可使藤壶皇后深深感动的话。

en.t: Among his words were some that moved Empress Fujitsubo deeply.

units.source_text: 她以前并非不曾有过错失，但倘如今再犯，实在说不过去。

en.t: It was not that she had never erred before, but if she were to do so again now, there would truly be no excuse for it.

units.source_text: 因此她此时虽然可怜源氏，但只是婉言拒绝。

en.t: Therefore, although she pitied Genji at that moment, she only refused him in gentle words.
In this way, the night passed.

units.source_text: 在源氏大将呢，也觉得对这个人不好意思作过分的要求，只是斯文一脉地说：

en.t: As for General Genji, he too felt ashamed to make excessive demands of her, and only said quietly and courteously:
"If things can be only as they are now, I am already fully content.

units.source_text: 今后若得时时相见，慰我刻骨相思，岂敢更有奢望？”

en.t: If from now on I may see you from time to time and soothe this love that pierces me to the bone, how could I dare hope for anything more?"

units.source_text: 藤壶皇后听了这话，也就安心了。

en.t: Hearing these words, Empress Fujitsubo was at last reassured.

units.source_text: 这样的一男一女，即使是普通的情侣，此时亦必增添惜别伤离之恸，

en.t: For a man and woman such as these, even if they had been ordinary lovers, this moment would surely have deepened the pain of parting and separation,

units.source_text: 何况这两个多愁善感的人，其痛苦不可言喻。

en.t: and all the more so for these two sensitive, sorrowful people; their suffering was beyond words.
